notes: Passive 70V/100V-distributed / 8-ohm-direct ceiling loudspeaker (2-way coaxial, 6.5in woofer + 0.75in tweeter); no AC/DC power input port exists since it draws all power from the speaker signal line itself. Official JBL spec sheet (issued 07/30/2025) states: "Two removable locking euro-block 2-pin connectors with screw-down terminals for bare wire. Connectors paralleled for input and loop-thru." Both terminal blocks are electrically identical/paralleled (either can serve as the amp-facing input while the other loops to the next speaker); modeled here as one Input and one Loop-Thru port for clarity. No grade applies (analog audio euroblock, not on any graded connector scale). Desktop/ceiling-mount unit, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Transformer taps: 70V at 30/15/7.5/3.8W, 100V at 30/15/7.5W, or 8-ohm direct (50W/200W-peak continuous, 75W/300W-peak 2hr rating). A related life-safety variant (Control 416C/T-VA, EN54-24) exists but this entry covers the standard Control 416C/T.

ports.name: Input
ports.note: 2-pin locking euroblock, screw-down terminals for bare wire (20 AWG min / 12 AWG max). Accepts 70V/100V transformer-tap or 8-ohm direct low-impedance signal from amplifier.

ports.name: Loop-Thru
ports.note: 2-pin locking euroblock, electrically paralleled with the Input terminal block, for daisy-chaining signal to the next ceiling speaker in the run.
